title: Decision engine response (v1)
description: What a decision engine answers. A section missing from decisions means 'no answer' (no-match): the section's Rule rows decide, else the authored content shows. Unknown top-level fields are ignored.

ttl.description: Seconds the answer may be reused for the same context. Default 300, capped at 1800.

cacheable.description: Edge only: the answer may be shared by visitors with the same context.

decision.description: One of: a listed variant (variant or fragment); the default chosen as the best fit (variant: "default" = intentional default); the control arm of a test or holdout (control: true); or no decision (reason only).

variant.description: A listed variant name, or "default": the engine chose the authored content as the best fit for this visitor (intentional default, not a test control).

fragment.description: A listed variant's fragment path. Site-relative only.

reason.description: Machine-readable code for why the engine gave no variant. Known codes: low_confidence, no_candidate, invalid_choice, provider_error. Other codes are kept and read as no-match.

tracking.description: Opaque engine data passed unchanged to measurement events and feedback. Never personal data.

control.description: The visitor is in the engine's control arm or holdout: the authored content shows and is reported as control.
